note: Jim Tcl (msteveb/jimtcl), a small but complete Tcl (lists, dicts, namespaces, expr with 64-bit integers, doubles and the math functions, strings, regexp, format/scan, upvar/uplevel, apply/lambda, try), built from its single-file bootstrap amalgamation autosetup/jimsh0.c as a 16-bit MS-DOS MZ .EXE with ia16-elf-gcc -mcmodel=medium. DOS-NATIVE: it runs on the bw-board 8086 DOS service bench, reads PROG.TCL via INT 21h and defines Jim's Tcl-coded library commands on first use from JIMLIB.TCL (jimlib.tcl). tools/jim-dos/mkdos.py lists every change to the amalgamation (16-bit int fixes, the namespace extension, Tcl 8.5's puts channel / entier / max / min, a stack-bounded recursion check, a heap that cannot grow into the stack, a 64 KB data-segment diet); tools/jim-dos/build.sh reproduces these bytes with the toolchain below. The toolchain is GPL and build-time only; the binary is BSD-2 Jim Tcl linked against newlib + libi86.
holder: Salvatore Sanfilippo, Steve Bennett and the Jim Tcl authors
